잠언-14-1.title: 잠언 14장 1절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-14-1.exegesis: 25. The comparative temporal prosperity of the righteous and wicked, rather than contentment and discontent, is noted.
잠언-14-1.theologicalNote: 25. The comparative temporal prosperity of the righteous and wicked, rather than contentment and discontent, is noted.

잠언-14-2.title: 잠언 14장 2절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-14-2.exegesis: CHAPTER 14 Pr 14:1-35 . 1. Every wise, &c.-- literally, "The wisdoms" (compare Pr 9:1 ) "of women," plural, a distributive form of speech. buildeth ... house-- increases wealth, which the foolish, by mismanagement, lessen.
잠언-14-2.theologicalNote: CHAPTER 14 Pr 14:1-35 . 1. Every wise, &c.-- literally, "The wisdoms" (compare Pr 9:1 ) "of women," plural, a distributive form of speech. buildeth ... house-- increases wealth, which the foolish, by mismanagement, lessen.

잠언-14-3.title: 잠언 14장 3절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-14-3.exegesis: 2. uprightness-- is the fruit of fearing God, as falsehood and ill-nature ( Pr 2:15 ; 3:32) of despising Him and His law.
잠언-14-3.theologicalNote: 2. uprightness-- is the fruit of fearing God, as falsehood and ill-nature ( Pr 2:15 ; 3:32) of despising Him and His law.

잠언-14-4.title: 잠언 14장 4절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-14-4.exegesis: 3. rod of pride-- that is, the punishment of pride, which they evince by their words. The words of the wise procure good to them.
잠언-14-4.theologicalNote: 3. rod of pride-- that is, the punishment of pride, which they evince by their words. The words of the wise procure good to them.

잠언-14-5.title: 잠언 14장 5절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-14-5.exegesis: 4. crib is clean-- empty; so "cleanness of teeth" denotes want of food (compare Am 4:6 ). Men get the proper fruit of their doings ( Ga 6:7 ).
잠언-14-5.theologicalNote: 4. crib is clean-- empty; so "cleanness of teeth" denotes want of food (compare Am 4:6 ). Men get the proper fruit of their doings ( Ga 6:7 ).

잠언-14-6.title: 잠언 14장 6절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-14-6.exegesis: 5. A faithful witness, &c.-- one tested to be such. utter lies-- or, "breathe out lies"--that is, habitually lies ( Pr 6:19 ; compare Ac 9:1 ). Or the sense is, that habitual truthfulness, or lying, will be evinced in witness-bearing.
잠언-14-6.theologicalNote: 5. A faithful witness, &c.-- one tested to be such. utter lies-- or, "breathe out lies"--that is, habitually lies ( Pr 6:19 ; compare Ac 9:1 ). Or the sense is, that habitual truthfulness, or lying, will be evinced in witness-bearing.

잠언-14-7.title: 잠언 14장 7절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-14-7.exegesis: 6. An humble, teachable spirit succeeds in seeking ( Pr 8:9 ; Joh 7:17 ; Jas 1:5 , 6 ).
잠언-14-7.theologicalNote: 6. An humble, teachable spirit succeeds in seeking ( Pr 8:9 ; Joh 7:17 ; Jas 1:5 , 6 ).

잠언-14-8.title: 잠언 14장 8절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-14-8.exegesis: 7. Avoid the society of those who cannot teach you.
잠언-14-8.theologicalNote: 7. Avoid the society of those who cannot teach you.

잠언-14-9.title: 잠언 14장 9절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-14-9.exegesis: 8. Appearances deceive the thoughtless, but the prudent discriminate.
잠언-14-9.theologicalNote: 8. Appearances deceive the thoughtless, but the prudent discriminate.

잠언-14-10.title: 잠언 14장 10절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-14-10.exegesis: 9. Fools make a mock at sin-- or, "Sin deludes fools." righteous ... favour-- that is, of God, instead of the punishment of sin.
잠언-14-10.theologicalNote: 9. Fools make a mock at sin-- or, "Sin deludes fools." righteous ... favour-- that is, of God, instead of the punishment of sin.

잠언-14-11.title: 잠언 14장 11절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-14-11.exegesis: 10. Each one best knows his own sorrows or joys.
잠언-14-11.theologicalNote: 10. Each one best knows his own sorrows or joys.

잠언-14-12.title: 잠언 14장 12절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-14-12.exegesis: 11. (Compare Pr 12:7 ). The contrast of the whole is enhanced by that of house and tabernacle, a permanent and a temporary dwelling.
잠언-14-12.theologicalNote: 11. (Compare Pr 12:7 ). The contrast of the whole is enhanced by that of house and tabernacle, a permanent and a temporary dwelling.

잠언-14-13.title: 잠언 14장 13절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-14-13.exegesis: 12. end thereof-- or, "reward," what results (compare Pr 5:4 ). ways of death-- leading to it.
잠언-14-13.theologicalNote: 12. end thereof-- or, "reward," what results (compare Pr 5:4 ). ways of death-- leading to it.

잠언-14-14.title: 잠언 14장 14절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-14-14.exegesis: 13. The preceding sentiment illustrated by the disappointments of a wicked or untimely joy.
잠언-14-14.theologicalNote: 13. The preceding sentiment illustrated by the disappointments of a wicked or untimely joy.

잠언-14-15.title: 잠언 14장 15절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-14-15.exegesis: 14. filled ... ways-- receive retribution ( Pr 1:31 ). a good man ... himself-- literally, "is away from such," will not associate with him.
잠언-14-15.theologicalNote: 14. filled ... ways-- receive retribution ( Pr 1:31 ). a good man ... himself-- literally, "is away from such," will not associate with him.

잠언-14-16.title: 잠언 14장 16절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-14-16.exegesis: 15. The simple ... word-- He is credulous, not from love, but heedlessness ( Pr 13:16 ).
잠언-14-16.theologicalNote: 15. The simple ... word-- He is credulous, not from love, but heedlessness ( Pr 13:16 ).

잠언-14-17.title: 잠언 14장 17절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-14-17.exegesis: 16. (Compare Pr 3:7 ; 28:14 ). rageth-- acts proudly and conceitedly.
잠언-14-17.theologicalNote: 16. (Compare Pr 3:7 ; 28:14 ). rageth-- acts proudly and conceitedly.

잠언-14-18.title: 잠언 14장 18절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-14-18.exegesis: 17. He ... angry-- literally, "short of anger" (compare Pr 14:29 , opposite idea). man ... hated-- that is, the deliberate evildoer is more hated than the rash.
잠언-14-18.theologicalNote: 17. He ... angry-- literally, "short of anger" (compare Pr 14:29 , opposite idea). man ... hated-- that is, the deliberate evildoer is more hated than the rash.

잠언-14-19.title: 잠언 14장 19절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-14-19.exegesis: 18. inherit-- as a portion (compare Pr 3:35 ). are crowned-- literally, "are surrounded with it," abound in it.
잠언-14-19.theologicalNote: 18. inherit-- as a portion (compare Pr 3:35 ). are crowned-- literally, "are surrounded with it," abound in it.

잠언-14-20.title: 잠언 14장 20절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-14-20.exegesis: 19. Describes the humbling of the wicked by the punishment their sins incur.
잠언-14-20.theologicalNote: 19. Describes the humbling of the wicked by the punishment their sins incur.

잠언-14-21.title: 잠언 14장 21절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-14-21.exegesis: 20. This sad but true picture of human nature is not given approvingly, but only as a fact.
잠언-14-21.theologicalNote: 20. This sad but true picture of human nature is not given approvingly, but only as a fact.

잠언-14-22.title: 잠언 14장 22절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-14-22.exegesis: 21. For such contempt of the poor is contrasted as sinful with the virtuous compassion of the good.
잠언-14-22.theologicalNote: 21. For such contempt of the poor is contrasted as sinful with the virtuous compassion of the good.

잠언-14-23.title: 잠언 14장 23절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-14-23.exegesis: 22. As usual, the interrogative negative strengthens the affirmative. mercy and truth-- that is, God's ( Psa 57:3 ; 61:7 ).
잠언-14-23.theologicalNote: 22. As usual, the interrogative negative strengthens the affirmative. mercy and truth-- that is, God's ( Psa 57:3 ; 61:7 ).

잠언-14-24.title: 잠언 14장 24절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-14-24.exegesis: 23. labour-- painful diligence. talk ... penury-- idle and vain promises and plans.
잠언-14-24.theologicalNote: 23. labour-- painful diligence. talk ... penury-- idle and vain promises and plans.

잠언-14-25.title: 잠언 14장 25절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-14-25.exegesis: 24. (Compare Pr 3:16 ). foolishness ... folly-- Folly remains, or produces folly; it has no benefit.
잠언-14-25.theologicalNote: 24. (Compare Pr 3:16 ). foolishness ... folly-- Folly remains, or produces folly; it has no benefit.

잠언-14-26.title: 잠언 14장 26절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-14-26.exegesis: 25. Life often depends on truth-telling. a deceitful ... lies-- He that breathes out lies is deceit, not to be trusted ( Pr 14:5 ).
잠언-14-26.theologicalNote: 25. Life often depends on truth-telling. a deceitful ... lies-- He that breathes out lies is deceit, not to be trusted ( Pr 14:5 ).

잠언-14-27.title: 잠언 14장 27절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-14-27.exegesis: 26. The blessings of piety descend to children ( Pr 13:22 ; 20:7 ; Ex 20:6 ).
잠언-14-27.theologicalNote: 26. The blessings of piety descend to children ( Pr 13:22 ; 20:7 ; Ex 20:6 ).

잠언-14-28.title: 잠언 14장 28절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-14-28.exegesis: 27. (Compare Pr 13:14 ). fear of the Lord-- or, "law of the wise," is wisdom ( Psa 111:10 ).
잠언-14-28.theologicalNote: 27. (Compare Pr 13:14 ). fear of the Lord-- or, "law of the wise," is wisdom ( Psa 111:10 ).

잠언-14-29.title: 잠언 14장 29절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-14-29.exegesis: 28. The teaching of a true political economy.
잠언-14-29.theologicalNote: 28. The teaching of a true political economy.

잠언-14-30.title: 잠언 14장 30절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-14-30.exegesis: 29. slow ... understanding-- (Compare Pr 14:17 ). hasty-- (Compare Pr 14:17 ). exalteth folly-- makes it conspicuous, as if delighting to honor it.
잠언-14-30.theologicalNote: 29. slow ... understanding-- (Compare Pr 14:17 ). hasty-- (Compare Pr 14:17 ). exalteth folly-- makes it conspicuous, as if delighting to honor it.

잠언-14-31.title: 잠언 14장 31절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-14-31.exegesis: 30. A sound heart-- both literally and figuratively, a source of health; in the latter sense, opposed to the known effect of evil passions on health.
잠언-14-31.theologicalNote: 30. A sound heart-- both literally and figuratively, a source of health; in the latter sense, opposed to the known effect of evil passions on health.

잠언-14-32.title: 잠언 14장 32절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-14-32.exegesis: 31. reproacheth his Maker-- who is the God of such, as well as of the rich ( Pr 22:2 ; Job 31:15 ; and specially 1Sa 2:8 ; Psa 113:7 ).
잠언-14-32.theologicalNote: 31. reproacheth his Maker-- who is the God of such, as well as of the rich ( Pr 22:2 ; Job 31:15 ; and specially 1Sa 2:8 ; Psa 113:7 ).

잠언-14-33.title: 잠언 14장 33절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-14-33.exegesis: 32. driven-- thrust out violently (compare Psa 35:5 , 6 ). hath hope-- trusteth ( Pr 10:2 ; 11:4 ; Psa 2:12 ), implying assurance of help.
잠언-14-33.theologicalNote: 32. driven-- thrust out violently (compare Psa 35:5 , 6 ). hath hope-- trusteth ( Pr 10:2 ; 11:4 ; Psa 2:12 ), implying assurance of help.

잠언-14-34.title: 잠언 14장 34절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-14-34.exegesis: 33. resteth-- preserved in quietness for use, while fools blazon their folly ( Pr 12:23 ; 13:16 ).
잠언-14-34.theologicalNote: 33. resteth-- preserved in quietness for use, while fools blazon their folly ( Pr 12:23 ; 13:16 ).

잠언-14-35.title: 잠언 14장 35절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-14-35.exegesis: 34. Righteousness-- just principles and actions. exalteth-- raises to honor. is a reproach-- brings on them the ill-will of others (compare Pr 13:6 ).
잠언-14-35.theologicalNote: 34. Righteousness-- just principles and actions. exalteth-- raises to honor. is a reproach-- brings on them the ill-will of others (compare Pr 13:6 ).
